detail.title: LLM Reasoning Blind Spots and Knowledge Gaps
detail.summary: Current LLM reasoning research distinguishes between procedural blind spots (unexplored search spaces in reasoning chains) and epistemic knowledge gaps (inability to recognize unknowns). Frameworks like Thought Space Explorer (TSE) address procedural blind spots through node-based path expansion, while knowledge gap awareness research focuses on meta-cognitive mechanisms like uncertainty quantification and reflective prompting.
